_note: Profiles and their on-board slots are read from Synapse (synapse_profiles.json). Each profile gets the Chroma effect with the most words in common (e.g. a profile called 'Gaming' <-> 'Chroma Effect Gaming'); effect_overrides forces a match when the names differ, e.g. {"Profile name": "Chroma Effect X"}. skip_slots: slots to skip (1 = Hybrid Storage, white indicator).

device._note: Leave pid out and the daemon finds the mouse by itself: the connected Razer device that Synapse lists as a mouse (never a keyboard). With several Razer mice connected, set pid to the USB product id (e.g. "0x00CB" for the Basilisk V3 35K; demonnapse.exe check lists them). The LED count and the Chroma Studio grid are read from Synapse's logs (synapse_device.json); set leds and chroma_grid ({"row,col": LED index}) here only to override them.

_lights_note: Press the profile button under the mouse lights_toggle_clicks times within lights_toggle_seconds to turn the lights off, and again to turn them back on; the profile you started from is restored. 0 disables it.
